scope: B11 integration source and focused test review before SDK

data_integrity.evidence: RestTimerViewModel.addTime/stop, WorkoutSettingsStore rest duration, SetRowView completion validation, RPE 6–10 half-step binding and rpeSourceRaw assignment, help ranges/RIR mapping are unchanged.

simplicity.evidence: Accessibility-size branches use existing AnyLayout/ScrollView patterns and one MAX-only AX identifier. No duplicated state or new abstraction beyond category-label rendering helper.

agent_native.evidence: No agent, prompt, tool, .claude or .codex instructions changed.

localization: No new user-facing app text or string catalog change; W08 AX identifier is not displayed. Existing localized category labels and help copy remain.
